label: 🧮 Math equation
description: Add a column computed from a math expression over existing columns. Supports arithmetic (+ - * / %), exponents (^ or pow()), and the usual math functions: sqrt, abs, log, ln, exp, sin, cos, tan, round, floor, ceil, mod, greatest, least. Reference columns by name, e.g. (price * quantity) - discount.

equation.label: Equation
equation.help: Math expression — e.g. (price * quantity) - discount, sqrt(a^2 + b^2), round(amount * 1.07, 2)

reference.label: Reference column
reference.help: Only used when Position = before / after — ignored otherwise.
